quotes.name: Elle Lilo
quotes.quote: Three clear days in a row — that's a gift around here. When I finally shook that cold, the first morning I stepped back on the bridge, the sky was wide open, and I swear I could feel it in my chest. The work doesn't change, not really — the tugs still pull, the horns still sound — but the day feels lighter. You can see the whole bay, the cranes, the gulls, all of it. It's like the harbor is breathing again, and so am I.

quotes.name: Rafael Brannie
quotes.quote: Three clear days helps, sure. I noticed the light today walking to the job—it's different, makes you want to linger on the corner a moment longer. But the winter mood, that's a heavier coat than the weather. It kind of stays draped on you even when the sun's out. I haven't gone out of my way to see people yet. I'm still moving, working, that part doesn't stop. But sitting with someone, sharing a beer, that takes a little more than blue sky. The mood outlasts the weather, I think. The sun gets you halfway there, the rest is on you.
